summary: Pivot Energy is the existing active U.S. distributed-solar and storage platform, so Energy Capital Partners must be alias-matched to the existing ECP owner rather than added again. A court receiver report directly identifies ECP IV-A/B/C/D as owners of the newly formed Pivot Energy, Inc. buyer, the $67 million asset purchase and the June 2021 transition from the TCA-controlled predecessor. ECP still lists Pivot as Current; later financing, HASI project-JV capital and Microsoft's framework are non-owner project/commercial relationships, and a reported sale process did not produce a disclosed signed transaction.
